steps.why: The repo pins TypeScript ^3.9.7, which cannot parse the template-literal types in the newer @types/express-serve-static-core that was resolved. Pinning an older types version (without saving) lets tsc parse it.

exclusion.reason: typecheck and build (tsc) fail parsing node_modules/@types/express-serve-static-core/index.d.ts because the installed type definitions use syntax newer than the repo's old TypeScript supports, a dependency/version mismatch in the repo's own setup that needs no outside access to fix.
